Within one Check, CHK resolves the current version (e.g. version 3) for its knowledge/queries; if a load run promotes a new version before DOC performs its own document-fetch step of that same Check, DOC independently calling CON-REG-007 would receive version 4's fetchMode/documentSource/requiredDocumentTypes while CHK's report records version 3 — two consumers of one Check silently disagreeing on which version they used.
